Home / House collections / Garden Court

Bustani · 0.2 – 0.6 acre

Garden Court

A low, wide house wrapped around a planted court. The roof is a working garden, the court is a rainwater sink, and the kitchen opens straight onto a productive vegetable bed.

KES 16.9M Price band
32 wks Build time
0.2 – 0.6 acre Plot range
3/4/4 bed Plans available

Why this design

Every room opens onto something growing.

Garden Court started as an answer to a client question: how do you grow food in a town plot without it looking like a farm? The court sits at the centre, planted with fruit trees and a raised bed, and the greywater system feeds it. Households on this plan typically cut vegetable spend by a third within the first year.
